Client project: Wilson International Education

Wilson helps Nepali students study in the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and the USA, and runs IELTS, PTE and SAT classes. They needed a steady stream of posts that look like one brand, carry a lot of information, and still read in two seconds on a phone.

  • Kept the Wilson logo, blue and orange palette and contact strip on every post, so the feed reads as one brand.
  • Built strong hierarchy: one big headline, one key number (a scholarship, a band score, an intake), then supporting details.
  • Edited and cut out student photos and model images, then blended them with campuses, skylines and country flags.
  • Designed for different jobs: promotions, student success stories, class ads, festival greetings and interactive quizzes.

    How I work

    A simple, repeatable process that keeps each post on brand and on deadline.

    Brief

    Understand the one action the post must drive: apply, enroll, call or comment. Collect the facts, fees, dates and photos.

    Layout

    Pick the format, set the grid and place the headline and key number first. Everything else supports them.

    Edit

    Cut out and retouch photos, match colour and light, and blend people with campuses, skylines and flags so they sit naturally.

    Polish and deliver

    Check spelling, contrast and phone readability, add the brand contact strip, and export at the right size for each platform.
